question: Which mantra makes worship most excellent in every respect?
premises: Worship can be performed with different mantras.
The speaker identifies a root mantra as their own.
Excellence in worship is being evaluated.
inference: Worship performed with the speaker's root mantra is the best in every way.
uncertainties: The identity of madīyamūlamantreṇa is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: Worship with my root mantra is best in every way.
